1.name: What Happened to Charlie
1.overview: Lawyer Charlie Quinn finds herself at a school during a shooting, which resurfaces traumatic memories; Charlie's father, representing the accused, tasks her with finding the shooter's mom; Charlie takes Rusty home, then gets a frantic call.

1.name: What Happened to Sam
1.overview: Sam Quinn heeds her father's plea to come home because her sister needs her; after a tense reunion, Sam covers Kelly Wilson's arraignment, but their meeting is interrupted by a fire alarm, leaving the mobility-impaired Sam in danger.

1.name: What Happened in New York
1.overview: Drawn into Kelly Wilson's case, Sam goes to the holler to talk to Kelly's mom; in the past, Charlie and Sam fight in New York City and become estranged; Sam masterfully handles Kelly's arraignment; Kelly makes a surprising revelation to Sam.

1.name: What Happened to Rusty
1.overview: Charlie and Sam investigate Kelly's past but end up fighting when she probes into her personal life again; on her way out of town, Sam has a good visit with Rusty, but sorrow plagues the Quinn family once more.

1.name: What Really Happened to Charlie
1.overview: Charlie finally tells Sam what really happened in the woods; while at the farmhouse searching for the Gamma photo, Sam discovers shocking evidence related to Zach Culpepper; the ominous sound of a vehicle evokes traumatic memories.

1.name: What Really Happened
1.overview: Huck shows up at the farmhouse, where, after a heated conflict, he makes a staggering revelation; Charlie, Sam and Ben figure out what really happened at the school and find resolution with each other, Rusty and Pikeville.

overview: Sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she’s forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.
